If the function EthTrcv_CheckWakeup() is called and EthTrcv WakeUpSupport is set to ETHTRCV_WAKEUP_BY_ASYNCHRONOUS_CHECK, the Ethernet Transceiver Driver shall store the request to asynchronously check for a wake- up of used Ethernet hardware (e.g. the OA TC10 compliant PHY) in the context of the EthTrcv_MainFunction.
